Elena Voss is a rare blend of technical precision and strategic vision, driving transformative outcomes in adtech at TargetLift Media. Her mastery of Agile/Scrum frameworks has consistently elevated team efficiency, reducing time-to-market for key products by 25% through streamlined sprint planning and cross-functional alignment. During the rollout of our dynamic ad placement engine, she restructured workflows to cut sprint cycles by 18%, enabling rapid iteration amid tight deadlines.  

Her project management acumen shines in high-stakes initiatives. Leading the integration of real-time bidding analytics, Elena coordinated 12+ stakeholders to deliver a 30% reduction in latency and a 20% cost savings in infrastructure costs—results that directly boosted client ROI by $2.1M annually. She thrives in ambiguity, translating complex technical challenges into actionable roadmaps that balance innovation with operational rigor.  

Elena’s cross-team collaboration has been pivotal to TargetLift’s scalability. By bridging engineering and data science teams on our audience segmentation platform, she resolved integration bottlenecks that had stalled progress for months, accelerating time-to-value by 40%. Her ability to align diverse priorities without compromising technical excellence is unparalleled.  

Beyond her skills, Elena’s relentless focus and collaborative mindset make her an indispensable asset. She approaches every challenge with intellectual curiosity and a commitment to excellence that elevates everyone around her. A standout professional who consistently delivers impact at scale.
